FWG coupled moisture consistency v1
Primary state: morphed dry bulb; station pressure; baseline q + smoothed climate delta q.
ASHRAE 2017: ice saturation at/below 0.01 C; liquid above; inverse uses same convention.
q bounded to [0,q_sat(T,p)]; RH bounded to [0,100]. T and p unchanged.
Moisture removal is an output adjustment, not modeled precipitation or latent heating.
Missing RH is preserved. Zero vapor or inverse below -70 C gives missing dew point (99.9).
Row numbers are 1-based weather records. Counts describe records, not duration.
Monthly means are over available records; RH adjustment excludes negative requested q.
saturation_limited=0; negative_q_limited=0; missing_RH=0; unrepresentable_dew=0
max_abs_q_adjustment_kg_kg=0.000000000; max_abs_RH_adjustment_percentage_points=0.000000000
